papers.title: Consistent Classification Algorithms for Multi-class Non-Decomposable Performance Metrics
papers.identity_evidence: Title/authors Harish G. Ramaswamy, Harikrishna Narasimhan, Shivani Agarwal on PDFp1; footer arXiv1501.00287v1[cs.LG]1Jan2015. Printed header April20,2022 is also retained; versioned URL identity, not inferred publisher version/date.
findings: P4Table1 explicitly labels multiclass MacroF1 non-concave and includes factor2 in the numerator. The following prose formula omits that factor; this audit uses the standard/Table1 normalization, not the prose typo.

P7Theorem2 characterizes an optimum through a gain matrix evaluated at an unknown optimal population confusion matrix, under posterior-distribution absolute continuity and metric regularity. It is not an algorithm using the current sample confusion matrix.
P13Theorem10/BayesCG consistency requires concavity and smoothness; MacroF1 is not certified by that result. P14 distinguishes population-confusion performance and sample-based approximation.

P4footnote distinguishes function of population expectations from expected finite-batch metric. Hard deterministic classifiers are included in the randomized-classifier framework, but token attention probabilities are not class posteriors.
limitations: Only pp1-8,13-14 read and pp4,7 visually inspected; remaining proof appendices, code and experiments not certified.
No priority clearance, no new theorem, no consistency/utility guarantee for current Q-RMEA.

papers.title: Designing Optimal Quantum Detectors Via Semidefinite Programming
papers.identity_evidence: PDFp1 exact title/authors Yonina C. Eldar, Alexandre Megretski, George C. Verghese; footer arXivquant-ph/0205178v1 28May2002. Printed header October23,2018 is retained independently, not treated as another arXiv revision or publisher date.
findings: Pp3-6 ensemble states with priors and a joint POVM summing to identity; objective sum_i p_i Tr(rho_i Pi_i) is correct-classification probability.
Pp7-10 dual construction and strong duality apply to that linear objective over the PSD/identity-sum convex set. P10eq15-20 gives the trace dual certificate and complementary slackness.
P11eq21-23 are minimum-error optimality conditions, not MacroF1 or the deterministic argmax of token-normalized affine utility logits.
limitations: Only pp1-11 read/p10 visually inspected. Later rank results, numerical methods/results and implementation not certified.
Independent binary token effects in original Q-RMEA are not a joint40class POVM; no global SDP certificate transfers to MacroF1 or current circuit-constrained training.
